title: VS-29 — Business Intelligence Enrichment & Smart Onboarding

notes: VS-29 is a gap-closing hardening slice over VS-25/26/27; it must not rebuild already-certified media/menu intelligence, Google Place enrichment, Business Hub, or Expo demo reset capabilities.
VS-29 extends the existing provider-neutral public discovery pipeline; it does not introduce a second enrichment architecture.

Remaining runtime deltas are bounded to public email/social extraction, one strongly matched official-site enrichment hop, targeted public Bolt parser hardening where supported page shapes are missing, truthful email/social/confirmed-hours materialisation, semantic suppression of redundant onboarding questions, and the corresponding mobile review/model wiring.

Public contact, social, hours, media and offering observations must retain source URL, provenance, observed time and confidence and remain subject to owner confirmation where canonical Business values are materialised.
Existing owner-confirmed Business/Profile/Context values are authoritative and must never be silently overwritten by refresh or enrichment.
DEC-07 remains controlling for media and offerings: retain remote HTTPS media references and structured facts, never copied third-party image binaries.

DEC-08 remains controlling for Google Places: rich Google content stays transient in the current owner interaction; no copied Google payload, photo or attribution persistence is permitted and no expanded durable Google contact/presence field mask is required for this slice.

Current EEA Places terms were reviewed at implementation start; because permitted-use categories are restrictive, durable VS-29 contact/presence enrichment comes from approved public/official-site sources and explicit owner confirmation rather than new Google-derived persistence.
DEC-09 remains controlling for navigation: preserve the certified five-tab route names/order/destination meaning; adapt onboarding UI to the post-VS-28 native shell rather than reverting it.
VS-30 Today’s Focus evidence compatibility and factual-evidence persistence guard must remain intact.
No persistence migration is expected. A genuine new schema requirement is a PES stop condition.
No production release, production enablement, EAS build/submit/OTA, deployment or production database mutation is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved proceeding through implementation, fixes, design adjustments where needed, certification and merge, while explicitly avoiding duplicate work already completed by prior slices. VS-29 is therefore narrowed to the verified remaining gaps only.

VS-29 remains inside approved DEC-04/05/07/08 public-source, progressive-question, media-retention and transient-Google boundaries. Current official Google Places and EEA terms were rechecked; no new durable Google content use is introduced.

Product Owner explicitly authorized implementation and fixes for the narrowed VS-29 remaining-gap scope, including bounded design changes when required, with Superpowers and relevant repository skills.
